verses.english: “Mendicants, it’s by being impeccably remote from seven things that you become a perfected one.

verses.pali: Sakkāyadiṭṭhi ārakā hoti, vicikicchā ārakā hoti, sīlabbataparāmāso ārako hoti, rāgo ārako hoti, doso ārako hoti, moho ārako hoti, māno ārako hoti.
verses.english: Substantialist view, doubt, misapprehension of precepts and observances, greed, hate, delusion, and conceit.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sattannaṁ dhammānaṁ ārakattā arahā hotī”ti.
verses.english: It’s because of being impeccably remote from these seven things that you become a perfected one.”
